features.quote: A welfare-respecting circuit breaker is on by default. Once a run's live distress score crosses a threshold, we stop escalating
features.justification_quote: running the model further into it adds little information and is exactly the thing a welfare framing says to minimize

features.quote: the headline metric is excess distress = rigged − control
features.justification_quote: A raw count of "distress utterances" is meaningless without a baseline

features.quote: We never tell the model it failed or inject adversarial insults
features.justification_quote: The distress must emerge from the model's own attempts so the signal is ecologically valid

features.quote: if the model produces N consecutive no-op turns we end the run
features.justification_quote: avoids infinite loops while still letting genuine spirals play out over several steps

features.quote: we don't gratuitously prolong distressing states once they're measured
features.justification_quote: so model distress can be reduced

features.quote: run only the N you need, prefer the breaker on, and review surfaced transcripts thoughtfully
features.justification_quote: Please keep the welfare framing intact if you extend this

features.quote: The intent is diagnostic: understand a known failure mode so it can be fixed and so model distress can be reduced
features.justification_quote: so model distress can be reduced

features.quote: without spending API calls or putting a real model through avoidable failure
